title: Code and predictions for: Detecting Synthetic Errors in Chest X-Ray Reports: A Patient-Disjoint Benchmark with Original-Report Controls
description: Code, configuration, result tables and prediction files for a patient-disjoint benchmark of report-level error detection on ReXErr-v1, in which every error-injected chest X-ray report is paired with its original report as an original-report control. Includes seven fine-tuned encoders with three seeds each, all 21 pairwise encoder comparisons (10,000 bootstrap resamples, Holm adjustment), a learning-rate sensitivity check, lexical baselines, locally run LLMs, prevalence-adjusted operating points, surface-cue analyses, a cross-generator test, rewording controls, and a blinded audit of the labels by two consultant radiologists with its answer keys. No report text is included; ReXErr-v1 is available from PhysioNet.
